welcome.title: Welcome to {{brand}}
welcome.subtitle: Go from visitor to active prepaid customer in a few clear steps.
welcome.body: Pick a plan, get a number, create your account, and confirm — you can go back any time.
welcome.prepaidNote: No contract and no surprises: your plan starts with your first top-up, and you can stop anytime.

plan.title: Choose a plan
plan.subtitle: Pick the plan that fits how you use your phone.
plan.empty: No plans are available right now.

assist.teaserBody: Answer 4 quick questions and we'll suggest one. It takes under a minute.

video.title: On mobile data, how much video do you watch?
video.hint: Count only the time you're away from Wi-Fi.

rarely.label: Rarely
rarely.hint: A short clip now and then

daily.label: About 30 minutes a day
daily.hint: Short videos and the odd episode on the go

hours.label: An hour or more a day
hours.hint: Streaming, live sport or video calls on the go

social.title: How much social media and music, away from Wi-Fi?

some.label: Some social and music
some.hint: Scrolling and playlists on the commute

lots.label: Lots, most of the day
lots.hint: Feeds, stories and music for hours

hotspot.title: Do you share your phone's internet with a laptop or tablet?

sometimes.label: Sometimes
sometimes.hint: A laptop on the train now and then

often.label: Often
often.hint: I regularly work from my phone's connection

travel.title: Will you use your phone in other EU countries?

yes.label: Yes, I travel in the EU
yes.hint: Use your plan just like at home

assist.estimate: We estimate you use about {{gb}} GB a month.

reason.unlimited: With unlimited data, you never need to keep an eye on your usage.
reason.biggest: That's more than any plan includes, so {{plan}} gives you the most. You can add data anytime.

assist.euRoaming: Includes EU roaming, so you can use it like at home.
assist.alternative: Often on Wi-Fi? {{plan}} with {{data}} could be enough and costs {{saving}} less.
assist.reassurance: Prepaid, so there's no risk: change your plan or add data anytime.
assist.summary: Suggested for you: {{plan}}, based on about {{gb}} GB a month.

plan.paymentNote: Prepaid, no contract: you only pay when you top up, and you can cancel anytime.

drei-up-start.tagline: Good for messages, calls and maps — mostly on Wi-Fi.
drei-up-start.description: A light starter plan for everyday messaging, calls and the occasional map or search. Best if most of your day is on Wi-Fi.

drei-up.tagline: Good for daily social, music and some video, plus EU trips.
drei-up.description: Our most popular plan: enough 5G data for daily social media, navigation and streaming music, with EU roaming for trips.

drei-up-max.tagline: Good for lots of video every day or regular hotspot use.
drei-up-max.description: A large 5G allowance for people who stream video daily or tether a laptop, with EU roaming included.

drei-up-unlimited.tagline: Good if you stream and share your hotspot without counting.
drei-up-unlimited.description: Unlimited 5G data — stream, tether and browse without watching a counter. Best for heavy users.

dreigo-go-8.tagline: Good for messages, calls and light browsing on a budget.
dreigo-go-8.description: A simple, low-cost plan for calls, chat and light data. A good first prepaid plan.

dreigo-go-20.tagline: Good for daily social and video, plus EU trips.
dreigo-go-20.description: A balanced 5G plan for everyday streaming and browsing, with EU roaming for travel.

dreigo-go-unlimited.tagline: Good for all-day streaming and hotspot, at home and in the EU.
dreigo-go-unlimited.description: Unlimited 5G data with EU roaming — stream and tether freely, at home and across the EU.
